title: retrace diff --format json, format_version 1
description: The document that `retrace diff --format json` writes (spec §8.4). Values read from a cassette, such as statuses, kinds and token sums, are not constrained further than their type: a cassette is untrusted input, and the document reports what it holds. Objects are open: a member added in a later version without a new format_version is backward compatible, so consumers ignore members they do not know.

format_version.description: Incremented, with a new schema file, by any change that is not backward compatible.

identical.description: True when the trajectories are identical, which is exit code 0, and first_divergence is null.

identical_steps.description: The steps before the divergence point, which are equal on both sides, or every step when the trajectories are identical. Null when there are none.

text_compared.description: True under --text, when the text of each model response is part of the comparison (spec §8.3 step 2).

text_differences.description: The steps whose text differs, in order, when text is not compared. Always present, and empty when text_compared is true.

session.description: A session and its totals (spec §8.2), with the same members as an entry of `retrace ls --json`, plus its strict stop.

ended_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, or null for a session that never ended.

dropped_events.description: Events missing from the session's event log (spec §7.7). When it is above 0, the divergence point may be caused by missing events.

cost_usd.description: The sum of the known costs, in US dollars. It leaves out the unpriced responses: a null cost is never guessed (spec §7.5).

unpriced_responses.description: Model responses with tokens but no known cost.

models.description: The distinct models of the session's responses, in order of first appearance.

duration_ms.description: ended_at minus created_at, or null for a session that never ended.

divergence.description: The session's first divergence event, its strict stop (spec §8.3 step 4), or null. A session can have the status diverged and no divergence event when the event was not written (spec §7.7).

channel.description: From the divergence event's result: llm or mcp, or null when the result does not hold it.

upstream.description: From the divergence event's result: anthropic or mcp:<name>, or null when the result does not hold it.

step.description: The step number. For kind stop it is the last step, and the stop marker is after it.

kind.description: The kind of event compared. model_response when the texts differ under --text, or when only one side has the step; stop when only the stop markers differ.

field.description: What diff is about. Null, with an empty diff, when the events differ elsewhere (kind, source, target, tool or status), when a side has no event, and for kind stop.

a.description: Side A's event, or null when side A has no event left in the step, and for kind stop.

b.description: Side B's event, as a is for side A.

stop_a.description: Side A's stop marker for kind stop, or null: also for a side with no model response.

stop_b.description: Side B's stop marker, as stop_a is for side A.

diff.description: The paths where field differs, with A as expected and B as received (spec §6.4).

diff_truncated.description: True when paths were left out of diff or a value was elided as "[retrace: <n> bytes elided]" (spec §6.4).

more_paths.description: True when more paths differ than diff lists.

event.description: The members of an event that action identity compares (spec §8.3 step 1), and its seq. arguments and result are the stored JSON, or a string when the stored value is not JSON.

marker.description: A stop marker (spec §8.2): the stop_reason of the last model response, or its error when its status is error.

failed.description: True when the response's status is error.

entry.description: One path that differs. A side without the path has no member: expected for A, received for B. A value whose compact JSON is longer than 1024 bytes is replaced by the string "[retrace: <n> bytes elided]", and diff_truncated is set (spec §6.4).

tool_calls.description: tool_call events in the span, counted on side A.
